coordinator_goal: Predict 100 drug candidates for Alzheimer's disease therapy. Classify every candidate along four dimensions: drug type, target category, action mode, and AD therapeutic mechanism. Assess delivery efficiency, accessibility, biosafety, multi-target synergy and effect durability, analyze mechanisms, and produce a ranked summary report.

batches.focus: diverse AD drug candidates across all four drug types (nano_formulation, biologic, small_molecule, other)
more diverse AD drug candidates — vary compositions, targets, and mechanisms; avoid near-duplicates
more diverse AD drug candidates — span different target categories and action modes; avoid near-duplicates
more diverse AD drug candidates — cover the remaining diversity of the AD drug space; avoid near-duplicates
